newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - July 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - July 11.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.

- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - Financial firms operating under China's industrial conglomerates have developed rapidly in the past 10 years with their combined assets hitting over 80 billion yuan by end-1996 and a total annual profit of about three billion yuan.
- A commentary says many statistics about China's securities industry are inaccurate mainly due to different standards for calculating the figures.
- The State Taxation Bureau has reaffirmed that foreign banks in China must pay taxes on the income derived from their loans offered within China.
- BUSINESS NEWS - The first batch of Sino-foreign joint venture foreign trade firms will soon start business, indicating a major reform in China's foreign trade sector.
